req.title: PUT rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-012 requires that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} returns HTTP 404 when the squad_number does not exist in the database. The endpoint uses squad_number (natural key) as the path parameter. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case confirming a known squad_number returns non-404 (proving the 404 path is conditional, not universal), (2) a negative/primary case confirming an unknown squad_number returns exactly 404, and (3) boundary cases at the edges of the known squad_number space (squad_number 0, squad_number 27 = max+1, squad_number 26 = max known). The route source shows: retrieve_by_squad_number_async returns None for unknown numbers, then raises HTTPException(status_code=404). Mutations to flip the condition or change the status code must be caught by exact-value assertions. All payloads use squad_number matching the path to avoid the 400 mismatch guard.

tests.name: test_put_known_player_returns_non_404
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid body where squad_number=10
expected: HTTP status code is NOT 404 (route found the player)
HTTP status code is exactly 204 (successful no-content update path)
trace: R-PLAYER-012: confirms 404 is NOT returned for an existing player, validating the conditional branch
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_known_player_returns_non_404():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code == 204
